summary: GI round 4, package PO: second-review offers (engine._routing_agrees, plus new _po_ helpers in validation/engine.py). An unresolved item the installed rule does not offer is OFFERED (the flag only: asking stays a member act, once per revision and date, and nothing is sent by any stage) when routing does not contradict the documented-service reading - PO-1: routing reads the item's family only silently (the minimal design's M1); PO-2: routing's not-today reading of the item's own passage comes only from a section that reaches it across a heading-like line the layout does not read - and the document is today's procedure report by its own head (sections.procedure_report_head, and no title of a note written around a procedure: sections.around_procedure_title). Only the offer flag on unresolved items moves, and only False -> True: no request, date, routing, inventory, proposal, question, check or completeness state. H2 expected delta: NONE.

amendment_20261101.why: The package's own refutation of the committed rule (sealed export of 0f2512471, synthetic texts only) found second-review offers on items not done today, in four classes. (1) Notes that are not a procedure's report pass the PS head guard - its sedation alternative matches the word anywhere in a head line ("She tolerated sedation poorly in the past.") and its performer alternative any "Attending:" or "Endoscopist:" field - and PO-1 offered the copied outside colonoscopy of a clinic, consult or follow-up note. (2) A procedure report of one family offered another family named only in a copied block: PO-1 an "EGD at Mercy GI." pasted from a referral packet, PO-2 a prior EUS copied under unread headings of a prior-studies section (routing reads the family there as another occasion's or as the runaway section's, and the inventory reads the copied conclusion heading as the service). (3) A statement that the procedure was called off or not done that names no family - "The procedure was cancelled before sedation", "No endoscopic procedure was performed today.", "Procedure not performed.", "Lower examination deferred to next week.", "Status: Cancelled - ..." - is attached by routing to no family, so routing's silence about the family was no agreement at all, and PO-1 and PO-2 offered. (4) sections.under_another_occurrence reads the nearest heading-like line only within 6 lines and 600 characters, so an unread heading naming an earlier EUS farther up ("What the Earlier Echoendoscope Showed") was never read. Each class is closed below by a hold; nothing is released.

rule_added.A1 document: a field of the document's head (its first sections.PROCEDURE_HEAD_LINES non-empty lines) whose LABEL names sedation or anaesthesia (sedation, sedative, anesthesia, anaesthesia, anesthetic, anaesthetic, anesthesiology): "Sedation:", "Sedation provider:", "Sedation and airway:", "Anesthetic care:" - in addition to sections.procedure_report_head and not sections.around_procedure_title
rule_added.A2 family: routing names the family on a title line of the head - one of its first sections.AROUND_PROCEDURE_TITLE_LINES non-empty lines, standing before the head's first field line, of at most sections.AROUND_PROCEDURE_TITLE_CHARS characters with no sentence end and no field value (the PS title test) - and that mention reads done today or says nothing; this replaces 'at least one mention' (a family routing never names has no title mention)
rule_added.A3 PO-2 evidence: an evidence span of the item lies on such a title line and says nothing: the documented-service reader takes the item from the report's own title, not only from the runaway passage
rule_added.A4 PO-2 reach: no heading-like line the layout does not read (beyond_heading_reach's own test of a heading-like line) between the section's heading and the passage names another occurrence's record (sections.ANOTHER_OCCURRENCE_HEAD), wherever it stands within the reach - in addition to sections.under_another_occurrence, which still reads the nearest short line and the passage's own line
rule_added.A5 document: no statement that a procedure was called off or not performed while naming none: routing's own cues.PROCEDURE_CANCELLED and cues.PROCEDURE_NOT_PERFORMED, and the forms they do not read - "no <one or two words> procedure|endoscopy|exam|examination|study was performed|done" (never "no other|further|additional|more|separate|extra|second ..."), "<procedure|exam|examination|study|endoscopy> (was) not (been) performed|done|started|begun|undertaken|attempted|carried out", "... did not|never|could not happen|occur|take place|start|begin|proceed|be performed|done", and a status or outcome field answered cancelled, not performed|done|started, postponed, deferred, rescheduled, aborted, called off or no-show; anywhere in the text (a closed list, read only to hold). An incomplete or aborted procedure that was begun is not held (incomplete is a performed reading)
rule_added.cost: the document facts (A1, A5, the PS head readers and the title lines) are read once per text - an lru_cache(maxsize=4) of engine, which jobs.release_routing_caches clears - not once per unresolved item; A4 reads at most sections.HEADING_REACH_LINES lines and sections.HEADING_REACH_CHARS characters
